observations: Three photos show a used automatic transmission unit in a workshop or scrapyard setting.
The unit is dusty and shows signs of wear, with visible bolts, fluid lines, and a central torque converter housing.
A label is visible on the front of the unit, but the text is too blurry to read clearly.
The unit is surrounded by other engine components, suggesting it is part of a larger salvage lot.
No visible branding or model identifiers are legible on the unit itself.
The seller claims it is an 'American Drive Gearbox Ford Fusion' with a 4-cylinder engine, but no such text is visible in the photos.
